parent_objective: execute the instrumented public rerun of the M1693 workload
blocked_by: need instrumented outcome-semantics rollout before interpreting M1693 dominant noncollision noncompletion outcomes

public_gates: M1698 may run the public instrumented 864-cell workload exactly once
M1698 must preserve M1693 workload, profiles, checkpoints, seeds, and actor input contract
M1698 must write outcome, termination-reason, and profile-outcome aggregates
M1698 must not train, replay, PPO, promote, use private holdout, tune profiles, or change actor inputs
M1698 must not claim controller-family ranking, paper-level evidence, or level3 self-ID
forbidden_shortcuts: do not drop failed cells silently

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: executes the instrumented public rerun needed for outcome-semantics audit
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: instrumented public rerun execution only; no training, replay, PPO, promotion, private holdout, controller ranking, paper-level or level3 claim
stop_condition: stop if required outcome fields are missing
stop if any failed cell lacks a failure row
stop if selected metrics are non-finite
stop if runtime requires workload reduction
fallback_plan: route to execution failure audit if rollout is partial or fails
route to outcome-semantics result audit if rollout completes cleanly
route to instrumentation repair if outcome fields are missing

admission_evidence: M1697 designs a same-workload instrumented rerun with required outcome artifacts
blocked_shortcuts: do not claim controller ranking or level3 self-identification
allowed_updates: M1698 status queue scoreboard research log and review
next_stage_criteria: 864 workload cells complete or failures are recorded

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: high; M1698 can measure instrumented public behavior but cannot by itself prove history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: execution must preserve L1, L2-current-tiled, L3-online, and L3-reset rows for later audit
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If reset/current-tiled controls match or beat history profiles, record that as history-necessity evidence gap during the later audit.
allowed_claims: no training, no replay, no PPO, no private-holdout, no promotion, no paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: The same 864-cell public workload can rerun with outcome semantics artifacts while preserving M1693 comparability and clean guardrails.
success_criteria: training replay PPO promotion private holdout actor-input changes and level3 claims remain blocked
failure_criteria: episode count profile count or spec count is below target without recorded failure
outcome fields or outcome aggregates are missing
training replay PPO private holdout promotion or actor-input changes occur
execution claims controller-family ranking or level3 self-ID

commands.name: instrumented_rerun
commands.command: run instrumented public controller-family rollout over the materialized workload

decision_rule: M1698 passes if it completes the instrumented 864-cell public rerun with outcome artifacts finite metrics and clean guardrails.
